# src.store.Store
# kaynak: src/store/api.py
class Store:
    def __init__(self, data_dir: PathLike, *, create: bool = True, readonly: bool = False, sync_catalog: bool = True) -> None
    self.data_dir
    self.readonly
    self.follows
    self.runtime
    self.streams
    self.watch
    self.events
    self.entities
    self.changes
    self.history
    self.backup
    self.export
    self.catalog
    @property
    def closed(self) -> bool
    @property
    def catalog_current(self) -> bool
    @property
    def jobs(self) -> JobStore
    @property
    def store_id(self) -> str
    def lease(self, name: str, *, purpose: str = '', wait: float = 0.0) -> Lease
    def lease_holder(self, name: str) -> Optional[LeaseInfo]
    def info(self, *, sizes: bool = True) -> StoreInfo
    def clear(self, scope: Union[str, Iterable[str]]) -> ClearReport
    def close(self) -> None
    def __repr__(self) -> str
